Requirement: Pyrokinesis (Novice)

Cost: 3 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 11

Test: None

You can increase the size and intensity of an existing fire, increasing the category (and therefore damage) of a fire-based hazard by one level. You can use shape fire repeatedly on successive rounds to continue increasing a fire hazard’s category, to a maximum of murderous and 6d6 damage. (See Handling Hazards in Chapter 8.)
